videos.script: Llama is the first family here that is open from the start. Meta publishes the weights, and most people run them on somebody else's machine. {{generations}} One file in Meta's repository lists every release: Llama 2, 3, 3.1, 3.2, 3.3 and 4. Some ship in several precisions. Some have no base model. {{moe}} Llama 4 is a mixture of experts. Each model has two sizes. The total decides whether it fits. The active part decides how fast it runs. {{card}} Its card adds languages, names Meta's own products in the training data, and stops in August 2024. {{hosts}} Last, the hosts. Ten of them, fourteen times apart on price, for weights that are meant to be the same.
